entries.title: Psalms 19:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> The heavens declare the glory of *God; and the expanse sheweth the work of his hands.

entries.title: Psalms 19:2
segments: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

entries.title: Psalms 19:3
segments: There is no speech and there are no words, yet their voice is heard.

entries.title: Psalms 19:4
segments: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their language to the extremity of the world. In them hath he set a tent for the sun,

entries.title: Psalms 19:5
segments: And he is as a bridegroom going forth from his chamber; he rejoiceth as a strong man to run the race.

entries.title: Psalms 19:6
segments: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, and his circuit unto the ends of it; and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

entries.title: Psalms 19:7
segments: ¶The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul; the testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple;

entries.title: Psalms 19:8
segments: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart; the commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes;

entries.title: Psalms 19:9
segments: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever; the judgments of Jehovah are truth, they are righteous altogether:

entries.title: Psalms 19:10
segments: They are more precious than gold, yea, than much fine gold; and sweeter than honey and the dropping of the honeycomb.

entries.title: Psalms 19:11
segments: Moreover, by them is thy servant enlightened; in keeping them there is great reward.

entries.title: Psalms 19:12
segments: Who understandeth [his] errors? Purify me from secret [faults].

entries.title: Psalms 19:13
segments: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous [sins]; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be perfect, and I shall be innocent from great transgression.

entries.title: Psalms 19:14
segments: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.
